definitions.gloss: extensive; wide-ranging; on a large scale
definitions.explanation: Covering a wide range of activities or dealings, especially in business. Almost always used as the adverb {手広|てびろ}く: {手広|てびろ}く{商売|しょうばい}をする, to do business on a wide scale.

examples.japanese: {手広|てびろ}く⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They do business on a wide scale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手広|てびろ}く⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げた→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧。
examples.english: My father expanded his business into many fields.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{手広|てびろ}く⟦{扱|あつか}っている→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: That company deals in a wide range of goods, from food to furniture.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand, one's dealings) + ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (wide). The plain form {手広|てびろ}い is rare; the adverbial {手広|てびろ}く carries the word. It describes the range of what someone handles, not physical size.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手広|てびろ}く⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do business on a wide scale
- {手広|てびろ}く⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧: to deal in a wide range (of goods)
- {手広|てびろ}く⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧: to have many irons in the fire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧: broad, wide-ranging — the general word (⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧, ⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧); {手広|てびろ}い is mostly about business.
